verdict.rationale: Canny's core product is a public feedback portal embeddable via widget (web/mobile) where customers submit and vote on ideas, with SSO/identify integration and a changelog to close the loop; this is well documented across install and widget docs. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party review confirming the voting/portal UX in practice, and no explicit customer-facing voting mechanic quote (only 'submit feedback on your Portal').
